free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: rank of the initial placeholder; the finding is about the global n_floats constraint, which is positive for any non-empty tensor, so a small rank keeps the z3 problem tiny without changing the decision

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: target graph size; the checked assertion runs after the generation loop regardless of how many nodes were inserted

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes python random and the z3 random/phase seeds so the generated constraint set and the solver result are reproducible

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: generation and per-check z3 timeout; 100 ms is ample for the tiny constraint systems, and it bounds the generation loop on the restricted (unsat) input

free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: fixed small operator list; the target assertion is reached even if the generation loop inserts no operator, so the operator choice cannot change the target decision

free_parameters.name: limnf_variant
free_parameters.why: NNSMITH_LIMNF_V=0 is the repository default: line 257 adds the single total n_floats <= limit_float constraint that the finding describes
